description: Department of Local Government W. P. -  Announce that a meeting in View of Selecting a new Mayor for the Vacated Mayor's Position of Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a meeting to select a new Mayor for the Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council, which falls under electoral processes for local authorities. The notice is made under specific sections of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendment, specifically addressing the filling of a vacated mayoral position through an electoral process at the municipal level.
